active.allowed_values: true when the reaction or upvote is added, false when removed

ai_feature.allowed_values: question_hint, question_tutor_chat, essay_ideas, essay_feedback, recommendation_letter, course_plan_outline, course_plan_chat, ai_question_generate, pdf_question_generate, study_plan, predicted_test, predicted_question
ai_feature.notes: Extend this list for new AI features; do not create new request events.

ai_request_id.allowed_values: Request id returned by the backend (P4-D2)
ai_request_id.notes: Join key to the backend AI usage log for tokens, model, and cost.

ai_result_score.allowed_values: Score returned by the feature, e.g. essay feedback overall score
ai_result_score.notes: Only for features that return a score.

answer_changed.allowed_values: true when the question already had an answer

answer_format.notes: image when a photo answer is attached.

answered_count.allowed_values: Questions answered so far in this attempt

assigned_count.allowed_values: Students the test was assigned to

auth_stage.notes: Splits auth failures by where they happen.

card_id.allowed_values: Card id from the hub config

cards_viewed.allowed_values: Cards viewed before the session ended
cards_viewed.notes: A floor; tab close is not captured.

change_type.allowed_values: cancel_at_period_end, downgrade_free, downgrade_monthly, auto_renew_off, auto_renew_on, time_limited_activate, class_cancel

checkout_type.allowed_values: course_cart, class_subscription, event, resource, tutor_plan, donation; tutor_session (Phase 7)
checkout_type.notes: Splits every revenue report by path.

completed.allowed_values: true when the last card was reached

content_id.allowed_values: Backend ID of the selected item
content_id.notes: Warehouse only. High-cardinality dimensions collapse into (other) in GA4 reports.

content_type.allowed_values: Search result type (e.g. test, tutorial, course); referral on share; test on test lists (Phase 2); course, class, event, resource, tutorial, college, scholarship, internship, applicant_profile, course_lesson, class_recording (Phase 5); essay_idea, essay_analysis (Phase 6); question, course_plan for authoring (Phase 7); user_profile, post, space (Phase 8)
content_type.notes: Shared vocabulary across search, content, and sharing events.

correct_count.allowed_values: Correct answers from the API result

course_progress_pct.allowed_values: Course progress percent after the lesson

creation_method.allowed_values: category, challenge, custom_builder, ai_predicted (Phase 2); manual, pdf_import, json_import, ai_generate, video_upload, video_link (Phase 7)
creation_method.notes: How a generated test was built.

cta_destination.allowed_values: Route template the CTA leads to
cta_destination.notes: Useful when one limit message offers more than one upgrade path.

cta_id.allowed_values: Fixed list per home component, e.g. continue_test, browse_tests, upload_score_report, build_plan_from_scratch, study_plan_due, view_assignments, goal_video, goal_event, study_guide, getting_started_item

days_ahead.allowed_values: Days from today to the chosen session date

days_until_due.allowed_values: Days from now to the assignment due date; negative when overdue

days_until_test.allowed_values: Days from now to the test date at the time it was set

description.allowed_values: Error code or HTTP status class, never a message; max 100 chars
description.notes: Keep it to codes so values stay low-cardinality and free of personal data.

destination_template.allowed_values: Route template of the nav target

duration_sec.allowed_values: Seconds spent on the question, from durationMs

endpoint_template.allowed_values: API path with IDs replaced by :id
endpoint_template.notes: Replacing IDs is done once, in the wrapper, so no event can leak a raw ID.

entry_point.allowed_values: header (donations, Phase 6); profile, my_students, connections, messages_page (conversations, Phase 8)

error_code.allowed_values: Firebase auth code (e.g. auth/wrong-password), HTTP status, or API error code. Never a message.

exam_category.allowed_values: Top-level exam category slug, e.g. sat, act, ielts

fatal.allowed_values: true for render crashes, false for API errors

feature_type.allowed_values: Server-supplied feature key from the limit payload
feature_type.notes: Supplied by the server's limit response, so it stays consistent with billing.

filter_type.allowed_values: category, date, price, level, location, other

gated_action.allowed_values: Server-supplied action key from the trial lock payload

has_due_date.allowed_values: true when a due date is set

has_media.allowed_values: true when the post includes an image or video

has_plan.allowed_values: true when the user has at least one study plan

has_referral.notes: Sent instead of the referral code itself.

http_status.allowed_values: HTTP status code, 0 for network failure

hub_id.allowed_values: Hub id from the hub config, e.g. question-bank-hub

input_chars.allowed_values: Length of the user's input in characters
input_chars.notes: A length only; the input text is never sent.

inviter_role.notes: Shows which side of the marketplace drives invitations.

is_cleared.allowed_values: true when a goal is set to empty

is_first_message.allowed_values: true for the first message in a support ticket

is_public_view.allowed_values: true when rendered by a public or public content route

is_update.allowed_values: true when editing an existing review

item_list_name.allowed_values: courses_grid, my_courses, classes_hub, calendar, resources, home_featured_classes, home_events, home_coming_up, search_results; tutor_plans (Phase 6)

items.allowed_values: Item objects; see the Item Schema tab
items.notes: GA4 ecommerce field. Item fields use GA4's built-in item dimensions.

latency_ms.allowed_values: Client-measured time from request to response
latency_ms.notes: Compare against the p95 targets: 3s conversational, 500ms embedded.

lead_type.notes: Extend this list rather than creating new lead events.

limit_type.notes: The main split for the upgrade funnel.

list_name.allowed_values: search_results, test_list, tutorial_category, tutorials_hub, home_featured_videos, colleges, scholarships, internships, applicant_profiles; tutor_directory, parent_directory, member_directory (Phase 8)
list_name.notes: For select_content outside the ecommerce lists.

list_position.notes: Register as a custom metric if needed in GA4, not a dimension.

marked.allowed_values: true when marked, false when unmarked

message_type.allowed_values: text, image, file, audio, video, gif, meeting

method.allowed_values: email, google on auth events; email on share
method.notes: Reused across auth and share events.

metric_value.allowed_values: LCP and INP in ms; CLS x 1000
